project.name: KHKD - Phorid Fly Dau Kien Rung
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — ruoi Phorid de trung vao dau kien, au trung an nao, dau rung
project.story: Phorid flies of the genus Pseudacteon are tiny parasitoids that inject eggs directly into the heads of fire ants in mid-flight. The egg hatches into a larva inside the ant's head, which then eats the ant's brain and consumes the muscles and tissue inside the head capsule. As the larva grows, it releases an enzyme that dissolves the membrane connecting the ant's head to its body. The ant's head literally falls off, with the larva inside it, where the larva continues developing until it emerges as an adult fly through the ant's mouth.
